trap-superlative.notes: Two content items reported to the batch. (1) UNSUPPORTED EMPIRICAL APPEAL, the strongest item in this block: 'This aligns with the empirical observation that nuclear physics is more robust against substrate compression than rarefaction.' There is no empirical observation of substrate compression - the substrate parameter q is framework-internal - and no citation, witness or measurement is given. The supporting arithmetic is also not stated: q_0 sits 0.728 from the sub-classical node and 1.508 from the super-classical one, so which margin counts as 'compression' depends on a sign convention the block never fixes. (2) PIN CURRENCY: 'The physical parameter $q_0 = 1.109978595554181\ldots$ (muon pin, 16 dps)'. That string is the OLD muon value; the current muon pin is 1.10997859555733471 and the owner-default compute pin (2026-08-07) is the proton 1.1099785827513808. The '16 dps' label is honest about the digit count, which is better than the usual '(50 dps)' mislabel - and the defect is cosmetic here, because all three pins give the same margins to 8 significant figures (see the verdict on tbl:golden-skew-dual-node-table-data).
